body_edits.diff: `V6.4 Secret Management` concentrates on how an application should use secrets, all important requirements, but what about inadvertently committing secrets, either as hard-coded or in a file/directory that shouldn't have been committed, e.g. pushing AWS keys in terraform or API tokens in `.bash_profile` to GitHub. There should be a requirement to verify secrets aren't ever being committed as it's very low effort but easily a huge win, i.e. pre-commit hooks with any of the number of excellent secret detecting SAST tools available.
